Store root for every `internal/...` and `docs/...` path: `/cursor/stores/bc-5bc79926-909c-4cfb-aa62-24b3a44735e2`. Plan section: `docs/server-pipeline-build-plan.md` §6 "WS-12". Items marked `[default chosen]` are decisions the plan, the review or the code left open; they are listed with rationale in `internal/build/layout-decisions-ws-12.md` (resolutions in `internal/build/decision-log-group-a.md`). ## 0. Card

- **WS-12, deployment, observability, cost.** Goal: one Modal app deployed per environment (`dev`, `prod`) from a clean checkout by CI, the GCP identity/storage plumbing codified in one Terraform root stack, promotion and rollback by pinned git SHA, JSON logs and a cost report per house, a dispatch-only GPU benchmark, and written GCP migration notes.
- Builder model: Grok 4.7. Validator: a separate agent (any model), never the builder.
- Inputs consumed: `server/modal_app.py` stub (`app`, `image`, `volume`, `smoke_cpu`), `server/common/{config,logging}.py`, `Makefile`, `scripts/fetch_fixtures.py` (WS-00); `server/api/modal_entry.py::api_app` and `GET /v1/healthz` (WS-01); `server/orchestrator/modal_functions.py` (`Pipeline`, `coordinate_run`, `run_cpu_stage`, `EarlyQa`, `early_reads`, `capture_check`, `sweep`) and `captures/{id}/runs/{runId}/{timings,cost}.json` (WS-03); `infra/terraform/modules/{capture_bucket,modal_wif}` + `infra/terraform/modules/README.md` wiring block (WS-01); `server/eval/replay.py`, `make e2e`, `.github/workflows/e2e.yml` (WS-11). Outputs produced: deployed app per env, `CAPTURE_API_URL`, Modal Secret names (→ WS-01, WS-03, WS-11, WS-14); GCP bucket, runtime SA, WIF audience, `gs://hss-fixtures` mirror (→ WS-00 `FIXTURE_SOURCE`, WS-01 `hss-<env>-gcp`, WS-11); `GPU_IMAGE`/`CPU_IMAGE`/`KNOBS` in `server/modal_app.py` (→ WS-03 decorators); `.github/workflows/{infra,deploy,gpu-bench,rollover}.yml` and `.github/actions/auth-gcp-oidc` (→ every WS, WS-11's `e2e.yml`); `runs/bench.jsonl`, `scripts/cost_report.py` (→ WS-13, hosted-architecture numbers); `docs/components/deploy.md`.
- Repo `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`. Three PRs: **A** `ws-12/deploy-modal` (Modal composition, Dockerfile, `deploy.yml`, `gpu-bench.yml`, `rollover.yml`, telemetry, docs), **B** `ws-12/infra-terraform` (root stack, copied modules, fixtures bucket, `infra.yml`, `ci.yml` jobs), **S** in the SMP repo, branch `house-scanning/substrate-onboarding` (§4.4). A and B may land in either order; S is a prerequisite of B's CI path or B uses the fallback (§4.6).
- **GCP layout decision (Hunter, 2026-09-26; supersedes review §4.2 "new project + standalone state bucket").** Reuse SMP's shared prod substrate: Terraform state in `gs://smp-substrate-tfstate-prod`, prefix `house-scanning/<env>`; GitHub Actions WIF through the existing pool `github-actions` in project `smp-shared-substrate` (its provider's attribute condition widened for `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`); at migration Artifact Registry, shared logging, shared monitoring and GSM secrets in the shared env project `smp-shared-prod`. A new GCP project `house-scanning` under the same billing account holds project-specific resources: capture buckets, runtime service accounts, the Modal OIDC pool/provider, the CI service account `hss-gha`, the project budget, and at migration Cloud Run services + job, Pub/Sub topics, Cloud SQL Postgres. Fallback if PR S is not applied when B starts: own pool and own state bucket in `house-scanning`, migrated later (§4.6). Narrowed IAM roles stay (§4.2).

## 3. Interfaces

**Runtime env contract** (review §4.4 = WS-00 `server/common/config.py` `Settings`, required names fail fast at construction; WS-01 §3.6 adds the API names). WS-12 supplies every value through Modal Secrets, never through code or the repo.

| Group | Variables | Source at runtime |

| GCP + backends | `GCP_PROJECT_ID=house-scanning`, `GCS_BUCKET=hss-captures-<env>`, `GCP_RUNTIME_SA_EMAIL=hss-runtime-<env>@house-scanning.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, `GCP_WIF_AUDIENCE=//iam.googleapis.com/projects/<HSS_PROJECT_NUMBER>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/modal-<env>/providers/modal`, `STORAGE_BACKEND=gcs` (`volume` until GCS is ready), `STATE_BACKEND=modal_dict`, `STATE_DICT_NAME=hss-<env>-state`, `MODAL_APP_NAME=house-scanning`, `CAPTURE_API_PUBLIC_URL` (SD-11 names) | Modal Secret `hss-<env>-gcp` (WS-01 §1.3) |

| Secrets | `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY` | `hss-<env>-vlm` (WS-03 §1.4) |

`server/modal_app.py` (WS-00's stub, extended by WS-12; module level imports only stdlib, `modal`, `server.common.config`). The deploy-time shell variable `SMP_ENVIRONMENT` selects the environment, as in WS-01's `modal_entry.py` and WS-03's deploy line:

```python
APP_NAME = "house-scanning"; app = modal.App(APP_NAME)                      # WS-00 names kept: app, image, volume
volume = modal.Volume.from_name("house-capture-pipeline", create_if_missing=True)
ENV = os.environ.get("SMP_ENVIRONMENT", "dev")
image = modal.Image.from_dockerfile("Dockerfile", context_dir=".", ignore=lambda p: p.name not in {"pyproject.toml", "uv.lock"}).add_local_python_source("server")
GPU_IMAGE = image                                                              # WS-03 imports GPU_IMAGE/image
CPU_IMAGE = modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version="3.12").apt_install("libgl1", "libglib2.0-0").uv_sync(extras=["api"]).add_local_python_source("server")
KNOBS = {"pipeline_gpu": os.environ.get("HSS_PIPELINE_GPU", "L4"),           # read by WS-03's Pipeline decorator
         "pipeline_min_containers": int(os.environ.get("HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS", "0")),
         "pipeline_max_containers": int(os.environ.get("HSS_PIPELINE_MAX_CONTAINERS", "3")),
         "pipeline_timeout_s": 1200, "pipeline_scaledown_s": 900}
def secrets_for(service: str) -> list[modal.Secret]: ...  # [from_name(f"hss-{ENV}-vlm"), from_name(f"hss-{ENV}-gcp"), from_dict({SMP_PRODUCT_ID, SMP_ENVIRONMENT, SMP_SERVICE_NAME, GIT_SHA})]
@app.function(image=CPU_IMAGE, cpu=2, timeout=1200, volumes={"/vol": volume})
def smoke_cpu() -> dict: ...                                                    # WS-00's import check, kept
# Composition (bottom of the module; the import cycle is intentional and documented):
from server.api.modal_entry import api_app        # noqa: E402  WS-01: hss-capture-api → app.include(api_app)
app.include(api_app)
import server.orchestrator.modal_functions        # noqa: E402,F401  WS-03: registers Pipeline, coordinate_run, run_cpu_stage, EarlyQa, early_*, sweep on `app`
```

WS-03's `modal_functions.py` imports `app`, `image`, `volume` from `server.modal_app` (never its own `modal.App`), so `modal deploy -m server.modal_app` and WS-03's dev-only `modal deploy -m server.orchestrator.modal_functions` deploy the same app. `Pipeline` (WS-03): `gpu=KNOBS["pipeline_gpu"]`, `cpu=8`, `memory=24576`, `timeout=1200`, `scaledown_window=900`, `min/max_containers` from `KNOBS`; `warm()` and `run_stage(run_id, stage, attempt)` are WS-03's methods (SD-32). API (WS-01): label `capture-api`, `min_containers=1`, `max_containers=1`, `scaledown_window=300`, `timeout=120`.

`server/bench.py` (port of `internal/modal-pipeline/bench.py`): ephemeral `bench_app = modal.App("house-scanning-bench")` with `@bench_app.cls(image=GPU_IMAGE, cpu=8, memory=24576, volumes={"/vol": volume}, timeout=1200) class BenchRunner` whose `run(house: str, spec: dict) -> dict` executes `server.orchestrator.legacy_run_packet.run_packet` (WS-00's move of `housepipe/pipeline.py`, timing reference only) on `/vol/packets/<house>.tar`; `python -m server.bench --env dev --gpu L4 --fixture eth3d-facade --variant arkit-nonlidar --max-frames 40,60,70 [--cold] --spend-stop-usd 40 --out runs/bench.jsonl` runs `with bench_app.run(): BenchRunner.with_options(gpu=...)()`. Record (`runs/bench.jsonl`, one JSON object per line): `{"kind": "run|smoke_cpu|latency_gate|stopped", "house", "tag", "gpu", "ok", "enter_s", "method_s", "client_s", "overhead_s", "est_usd", "est_usd_busy", "timings_s": {...}, "frames_registered", "gpu_memory", "error", "git_sha"}`; rate card = `GPU_PRICES_USD_PER_S` + `CPU_USD_PER_S`·8 + `MEM_USD_PER_GIB_S`·24 (L4 ≈ $0.00038/s ≈ $1.37/h). End-to-end latency (p50 3 min / p95 8 min) comes from WS-11 `make e2e` (`finalize_to_verdict_s`) and WS-03 `timings.json`, not from this bench.

Telemetry (`server/common/telemetry.py`): `log_event(event: str, **fields) -> None` writes one JSON line to stdout with keys `ts` (RFC 3339 UTC), `level`, `event`, `msg`, `service.name`, `deployment.environment`, `product`, `git_sha`, plus optional `capture_id`, `run_id`, `stage`, `attempt`, `duration_ms`, `gpu`, `vlm_provider`, `vlm_model`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `vlm_cost_usd`, `disagreement` (bool), `error_code`. `StageTimer(stage, capture_id, run_id, attempt)` context manager emits `stage_started` / `stage_finished` (`duration_ms`) / `stage_failed` (`error_code`). `VlmCostMeter.add(provider, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, usd)` emits `vlm_call` and accumulates for `cost_summary` (`gpu_s`, `gpu_usd`, `vlm_usd`, `total_usd`, `time_to_verdict_s`). Never log image bytes, tokens, meter numbers or prompt text.

Terraform root variables (`infra/terraform/variables.tf`): `project_id` (string), `region` (`"us-central1"`), `product_id` (`"house-scanning"`), `environment` (validation `dev|prod`), `owner` (`"huntertcarver"`), `manage_project_resources` (bool, false), `billing_account` (string, null), `monthly_budget_amount` (number, null), `github_repository` (`"huntertcarver/house-scanning-server"`), `github_wif_mode` (validation `shared|own`, default `shared`), `github_wif_pool_name` (string, null), `github_wif_provider_name` (string, null), `create_state_bucket` (bool, false), `state_bucket_name` (`"hss-tfstate"`), `fixtures_bucket_name` (`"hss-fixtures"`), `modal_workspace_id` (string). Outputs (`outputs.tf`): `project_number`, `github_wif_provider_name`, `github_sa_email`, `modal_wif_audience`, `runtime_sa_email`, `capture_bucket`, `fixtures_bucket`.

Modules consumed from WS-01 (their brief §3.7; request changes through WS-01, never edit): `capture_bucket` variables `project_id, environment, location="us-central1", bucket_name=null (→ hss-captures-<env>), owner, upload_ttl_days=7, nearline_after_days=30, abort_multipart_after_days=1, cors_origins=[], object_admin_members=[], object_viewer_members=[], force_destroy=false, extra_labels={}`, outputs `bucket_name, bucket_url, bucket_self_link`; `modal_wif` variables `project_id, project_number (string input), environment, modal_workspace_id, modal_environment_name=null (→ environment), pool_id=null (→ modal-<env>), provider_id="modal", runtime_sa_id=null (→ hss-runtime-<env>)`, outputs `runtime_sa_email, modal_wif_audience` (+ pool/provider names). Shape: **one pool per environment** `modal-<env>` with one provider `modal` (issuer `https://oidc.modal.com`, `allowed_audiences=["oidc.modal.com"]`, `google.subject = "modal/" + workspace_id + "/" + environment_name + "/" + app_name`, condition on `workspace_id` and `environment_name`), runtime SA `hss-runtime-<env>` with `roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser` for the pool's `attribute.environment_name/<env>` principal set and `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` on itself; the bucket grant comes from `capture_bucket.object_admin_members = ["serviceAccount:<runtime_sa_email>"]`. The exact two module calls and outputs are the block in WS-01's `infra/terraform/modules/README.md`; paste it, do not retype it.

GitHub configuration Hunter creates (names only): repo variables `GCP_PROJECT_ID`, `GCP_WIF_PROVIDER`, `GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`, `TF_BACKEND_BUCKET`, `FIXTURE_SOURCE`; environments `dev` and `prod`, each with secrets `MODAL_TOKEN_ID`, `MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET`, `CAPTURE_API_TOKEN` and variable `CAPTURE_API_URL` (optional variables `HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS`, `HSS_PIPELINE_MAX_CONTAINERS`, `HSS_PIPELINE_GPU`); `prod` has deployment branch policy `main` only and required reviewer Hunter `[default chosen]`. Values: §4.3 step 5.

## 4. Behaviour spec

### 4.1 Modal app layout

1. One deployed app `house-scanning` `[default chosen]` per Modal environment `dev` and `prod` (`modal environment create dev`, `prod`; web suffix = environment name), composed in `server/modal_app.py` from WS-01's `api_app` (`app.include`) and WS-03's functions (§3). Deployed URL: `https://huntertcarver-<env>--capture-api.modal.run` (WS-01's label `capture-api`; confirm from `modal deploy` output; it becomes `CAPTURE_API_URL`). `SMP_ENVIRONMENT=<env>` in the deploy shell selects the Secret names; the same value is injected into containers by `secrets_for`.
2. Two images. `Dockerfile` (GPU pipeline; portable): `FROM nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-devel-ubuntu22.04@sha256:<digest from docker buildx imagetools inspect>`; the exact apt list and COLMAP build of `internal/modal-pipeline/app.py::COLMAP_BUILD` with the tag moved from `3.11.1` to the COLMAP release the `pycolmap==4.2.0` wheel is built against (SD-34 `[provisional: WS-04]`: the harness, packetgen, A1 and A6 measured on 4.2.0, the 3.11.1 image never completed a house, and the SQLite schema changed at 3.12, so a 3.11.1 binary under a 4.x wheel is forbidden; `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="80;86;89;90"`, `-DGUI_ENABLED=OFF -DTESTS_ENABLED=OFF`, `ninja -j3`; verify `colmap -h` and `pycolmap.__version__` agree on major.minor in the build); `COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:<uv --version> /uv /uvx /bin/`; `uv python install 3.12` (WS-00 fixed the repo on 3.12 and expects WS-12 to confirm the image); `COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock`; `uv sync --frozen --no-install-project --no-dev --extra gpu` then `uv pip install pip` into the venv (Modal installs its client with pip); `ENV PATH=/app/.venv/bin:$PATH HF_HOME=/vol/hf HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE=/vol/hf/hub TORCH_HOME=/vol/torch PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1`. No application code in the Dockerfile: Modal adds `server/` with `add_local_python_source` and WS-13's meter table with `image.add_local_dir("data/meter-models", remote_path="/root/data/meter-models")` (the only non-code directory, SD-59), so code and table changes never rebuild layers. Extra `gpu` pins exactly app.py's set: `torch==2.5.1`, `torchvision==0.20.1` from index `https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124` (`[tool.uv.sources]`, explicit index), `numpy==1.26.4`, `pycolmap==4.2.0` (cp312 wheel; if none exists, build it in the image from the same COLMAP checkout and say so), `opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84`, `scipy==1.13.1`, `huggingface_hub==0.26.2`, `safetensors==0.4.5`, `einops==0.8.0`, `plyfile==1.1`, `pillow==10.4.0`, `tqdm==4.66.5`, and the three tarball URLs at their commits (Pi3 `9fa3ddb3f8d53041f8b2738df404f62223bbaa7b`, MoGe `925b8ed835a7a9cdb7578ba15c658a0afc969030`, Depth-Anything-3 `3d835ec1a5802d64a8b8b15f817a1ab54809bfe4`) plus WS-03's early-worker pins (`open_clip_torch`, `transformers`, `zxing-cpp`, `openai`) if WS-03 keeps `EarlyQa` on the GPU image; add `[tool.uv] override-dependencies` for torch/torchvision if a tarball pins otherwise (app.py had to re-pin torch). `CPU_IMAGE` (`debian_slim(python_version="3.12").uv_sync(extras=["api"])`) replaces WS-03's `images.py::CPU_IMAGE` and WS-01's `pip_install_from_pyproject` image with identical pins; WS-01/WS-03 switch their decorators to `server.modal_app.{GPU_IMAGE,CPU_IMAGE}` in a one-line follow-up each.
3. Build cost (measured 2026-09-26, `internal/modal-pipeline/runs/bench.log`): COLMAP layer 404 s (1.0 GB), torch 71 s (4.4 GB), pinned pip 28 s, model tarballs 107 s; about 10 min cold (a clean compile measured 609 s in the 22:28 benchmark), seconds when cached: prebuild once per lock change and pin the image id in the deploy summary. Cold container `enter_s` 19–50 s (weights from the volume; 50 s when downloading; 15–22 s after the image pin). `scripts/prefetch_weights.py` (`modal run`, per environment) fills `/vol/hf` before the demo.
4. Pinning: every version in `pyproject.toml`/`uv.lock` (`--frozen` everywhere), base image by digest, model repos by commit, deployment tagged with the 12-char git SHA (`modal deploy --tag`), image cache key = Dockerfile + lock content.
5. Volume `house-capture-pipeline` per environment (`hf/ packets/ results/ captures/`); Secrets `hss-<env>-vlm`, `hss-<env>-api`, `hss-<env>-gcp` (keys in §3; `hss-<env>-r2` only on WS-01's R2 fallback) created by Hunter with `modal secret create <name> KEY=VALUE ... -e <env>`; the repo holds names only; no service-account JSON anywhere (WIF fallback: an SA key in `hss-<env>-gcp` documented as debt in `docs/components/deploy.md`).
6. Prewarm knobs (`KNOBS`, deploy-time env, `[default chosen]`): `HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS` 0 (set 1 for the demo window; idle L4 ≈ $0.80/h), `HSS_PIPELINE_MAX_CONTAINERS` 3 dev / 6 prod, `HSS_PIPELINE_GPU` `L4`; fixed by WS-03/WS-01: `Pipeline.timeout` 1200 s (coordinator 1560 s enforces the 20-min hard stop), `scaledown_window` 900 s pipeline / 600 s `EarlyQa` / 300 s API, API `min_containers=1`, `max_containers=1` (in-process lock while `STATE_BACKEND=modal_dict`). WS-03 calls `Pipeline().warm.spawn()` on `POST /captures` and escalates with `Pipeline.with_options(gpu="A100-40GB")`. Warm policy (SD-33; the 22:28 benchmark saw every call boot, 30–76 s overhead, under `scaledown_window=900`): WS-03 records `enter_s` per stage attempt in `run/timings.json`; set `HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS=1` for demo windows and whenever the first e2e runs show a warm-hit rate below 80 %.
7. Spend guardrails: Modal workspace budget and spend limit $200 (Usage & Billing page, Hunter; not settable from the repo); environment budgets `dev` $140 / `prod` $60 `[default chosen]`; GPU only in `Pipeline` and `BenchRunner`; bench dispatch-only with caps (§4.5), WS-11's nightly `e2e.yml` one run per day; `modal environment billing summary <env>` appended to every deploy summary; GCP budget $50 with 50 % / 90 % alerts from `project_baseline`. This WS may spend $25 of the $200 (stop and report at $20); the bench has its own $40 per-process stop.

### 4.2 Terraform root stack (`infra/terraform/`), file by file

| File | Content |
|---|---|

Mirror of every `data/fixtures/manifest.json` source path with the `$S/internal`-relative layout (WS-00 §4 step 13; `FIXTURE_SOURCE=gs://hss-fixtures`). |

`<SUBSTRATE_PROJECT_NUMBER>` = `gcloud projects describe smp-shared-substrate --format='value(projectNumber)'`; `<PROVIDER_ID>` = `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers list --workload-identity-pool=github-actions --location=global --project=smp-shared-substrate --format='value(name)'` (module default `architecture-design-decisions`).

Module calls (`main.tf`): project-scoped modules exist only in the `prod` state (`count = var.manage_project_resources ? 1 : 0`) `[default chosen]`, so `dev` and `prod` never fight over the same resource:

- `module "project_baseline"` (copy of SMP `shared-assets/delivery/terraform-governance-pack/modules/gcp_project_env_baseline`): `create_project=false`, `project_name=var.project_id`, `environment=var.environment`, `billing_account`, `monthly_budget_amount`, `required_apis = ["storage.googleapis.com","iam.googleapis.com","iamcredentials.googleapis.com","sts.googleapis.com","secretmanager.googleapis.com","billingbudgets.googleapis.com","cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com","serviceusage.googleapis.com"]`, `labels=local.base_labels`. Budget thresholds 50 %/90 % come from the module.
- `module "github_sa"` (copy of `.../modules/github_actions_service_account`): `service_account_id="hss-gha"` (one CI SA for both environments `[default chosen]`), `display_name="house-scanning GitHub Actions"`, `description="Terraform plan/apply from huntertcarver/house-scanning-server via WIF"`, `workload_identity_pool_name=local.github_wif_pool_name`, `repository=var.github_repository`, `project_roles = ["roles/storage.admin","roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin","roles/iam.workloadIdentityPoolAdmin","roles/serviceusage.serviceUsageAdmin","roles/secretmanager.admin","roles/iam.securityReviewer"]` (the last is read-only IAM so CI `plan` can read project IAM `[default chosen]`), `billing_account=var.billing_account`, `billing_account_roles=["roles/billing.costsManager"]` (the budget is CI-planned). **No `roles/viewer`, no `roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin`.** Changes to `hss-gha`'s own role bindings are applied by Hunter locally; a CI apply containing them fails with 403 by design.
- `module "github_wif"` (copy of `.../modules/github_actions_workload_identity`, `count` also requires `github_wif_mode == "own"`): `workload_identity_pool_id="github-actions"`, `workload_identity_provider_id="house-scanning-server"`, display names `"house-scanning-server"`, `allowed_refs=["refs/heads/main"]`, `additional_attribute_conditions=[local.dev_subject_condition]` (local module extension, §4.4 item 1, noted in the module README).
- `module "state_bucket"` (copy of `.../modules/gcs_backend_baseline`, `count` also requires `create_state_bucket`): `bucket_name=var.state_bucket_name`, `location="US"`, `admin_members=["serviceAccount:${module.github_sa[0].email}"]`, `labels=local.base_labels`.
- `module "modal_wif"` and `module "capture_bucket"` (WS-01, every state; each environment has its own pool `modal-<env>`, so no project-scoped conflict): exactly the block in WS-01's `infra/terraform/modules/README.md`, i.e. `modal_wif` with `project_id`, `project_number = data.google_project.this.number`, `environment = var.environment`, `modal_workspace_id`; `capture_bucket` with `project_id`, `environment`, `location = var.region`, `owner = var.owner`, `object_admin_members = ["serviceAccount:${module.modal_wif.runtime_sa_email}"]`, `cors_origins = []` (WS-01 default: the reviewer page loads assets through the API's signed URLs).

Each copied module keeps SMP's files byte-for-byte except the `github_wif` extension, and gets a `README.md` whose first line is `SOURCE: huntertcarver/Software-Manufacturing-Plant@38b696f shared-assets/delivery/terraform-governance-pack/modules/<original name>` followed by `LOCAL CHANGES:` (none, or the extension). Never reference SMP as a `git::` module source.

### 4.3 Bootstrap order (shared path)

1. Hunter (project owner on `house-scanning`, owner on `smp-shared-substrate`, billing admin), from his Mac with ADC (`gcloud auth application-default login`): `gcloud projects create house-scanning --name=house-scanning` (if the id is taken, pick `house-scanning-<suffix>` and change only `project_id` in both tfvars); `gcloud billing projects link house-scanning --billing-account=<ID>`; `gcloud services enable cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com serviceusage.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com iamcredentials.googleapis.com sts.googleapis.com storage.googleapis.com secretmanager.googleapis.com billingbudgets.googleapis.com --project=house-scanning`.
2. `cd infra/terraform && terraform init -backend-config=bucket=smp-substrate-tfstate-prod -backend-config=prefix=house-scanning/prod && terraform apply -var-file=env/prod.tfvars`. State goes straight to the shared bucket (his identity already has access); no local state and no migration on this path. Creates APIs, budget, `hss-gha` + roles, `hss-fixtures`, pool `modal-prod`, `hss-runtime-prod`, `hss-captures-prod`.
3. `terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=bucket=smp-substrate-tfstate-prod -backend-config=prefix=house-scanning/dev && terraform apply -var-file=env/dev.tfvars` (use a second working copy or `rm -rf .terraform` between environments so the two backends never share a directory). Then mirror the fixtures once from a machine that has both the store copy and gcloud ADC (Hunter's Mac via `scripts/sync_breadth.sh`): `gcloud storage rsync -r $S/internal/data/packets/archives gs://hss-fixtures/data/packets/archives` and the GT PLY directories WS-00's manifest lists (same `$S/internal`-relative paths).
4. PR S merged and applied (§4.4): the substrate provider now accepts the server repo and `hss-gha` can read/write `house-scanning/` in the state bucket. Ordering matters: the bucket IAM member must exist as a service account before SMP's apply, hence step 2 first.
5. Hunter sets GitHub variables from `terraform output -json` and the derivations above: `GCP_PROJECT_ID=house-scanning`, `GCP_WIF_PROVIDER=<github_wif_provider_name>`, `GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL=hss-gha@house-scanning.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, `TF_BACKEND_BUCKET=smp-substrate-tfstate-prod`, `FIXTURE_SOURCE=gs://hss-fixtures`; creates Modal Secrets `hss-<env>-gcp` from `modal_wif_audience`, `runtime_sa_email`, `capture_bucket` (plus `STORAGE_BACKEND=gcs`, `STATE_BACKEND=modal_dict`, `STATE_DICT_NAME=hss-<env>-state`, `MODAL_APP_NAME=house-scanning`, `CAPTURE_API_PUBLIC_URL`).
6. Dispatch `infra.yml` with `env=dev`, `apply=false`: `init` + `plan` succeed with no changes. Then `env=prod`, `apply=false`. From here every change to `infra/terraform/**` goes PR → dispatch plan (artifact) → merge → dispatch `apply=true`.

### 4.4 SMP repo PR S: substrate onboarding (separate task, own Done-when in §8)

Base: SMP `main` (≥ `38b696f`). Files:

1. `shared-assets/delivery/terraform-governance-pack/modules/github_actions_workload_identity/variables.tf`: add `variable "additional_attribute_conditions" { type = list(string)  default = [] }`. `locals.tf`: keep the existing `attribute_condition` string unchanged when the list is empty; otherwise `join(" || ", concat(["(assertion.repository == \"${var.repository}\" && (${local.ref_condition}))"], var.additional_attribute_conditions))`. Backward compatible: no plan diff for existing callers.
2. `shared-assets/delivery/shared-baseline-substrate/variables.tf`: add `additional_github_attribute_conditions` (`list(string)`, `[]`) and `product_ci_state_access` (`map(object({ bucket = string, prefix = string, member = string }))`, `{}`).

The substrate stack's WIF module call (the `module` block whose `source` ends in `modules/github_actions_workload_identity`; find it with `grep -rn github_actions_workload_identity shared-assets/delivery/shared-baseline-substrate/*.tf`): pass `additional_attribute_conditions = var.additional_github_attribute_conditions`. Do not add a second module instance (it would create a second pool) and do not add a second provider with the same issuer.

```hcl
resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "product_state_object_admin" {
  for_each = var.product_ci_state_access

```

   If a later `terraform init` from the server repo's CI fails with `storage.buckets.get` denied, add a second member binding `roles/storage.legacyBucketReader` (bucket-level, no condition) in the same file; `objectAdmin` alone matched chatgraph's onboarding.

Validate the way SMP's `AGENTS.md` prescribes for that repo (`terraform fmt -check`, `init -backend=false`, `validate` in the stack, `python3 tools/validators/run_all.py`); SMP's own PR checks (`validate-shared-*.yaml`) must be green. Apply through SMP's `bootstrap-shared-substrate.yaml` dispatch (environment `substrate`) or by Hunter locally (`init -backend-config=bucket=smp-substrate-tfstate-substrate -backend-config=prefix=shared-platform/substrate`, var file `env/shared-platform.tfvars`). Expected plan: exactly one in-place update (the provider's `attribute_condition`) and one create (the bucket IAM member). The state key `house-scanning/<env>` follows `backend-conventions.yaml` (`<product>/<environment>`), so no convention change.

### 4.5 CI workflows (server repo)

All workflows: `permissions: contents: read` (plus `id-token: write` only where GCP auth happens), `actions/checkout@v4`, `astral-sh/setup-uv@v6` with `enable-cache: true`, `uv sync --frozen --no-dev`, `hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3` with `terraform_version: "1.8.5"` and `terraform_wrapper: false`, `timeout-minutes` set. `.github/actions/auth-gcp-oidc/action.yaml` is SMP's copied verbatim (inputs `workload_identity_provider`, `service_account` → `google-github-actions/auth@v2` → `google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v2`; write an equivalent composite if SMP is unreachable and say so in the README header).

| Workflow | Trigger | Job essentials |
|---|---|---|
| `ci.yml` (+3 jobs) | `pull_request`, `push` to `main` (existing) | `terraform`: `terraform -chdir=infra/terraform fmt -check -recursive`, `init -backend=false`, `validate`. `modal-check` (`if: hashFiles('server/modal_app.py') != ''`, so B can land before A): `SMP_ENVIRONMENT=dev uv run python -c "import server.modal_app"` (catches image/decorator errors without deploying, no Modal token). `workflows-lint`: actionlint 1.7.7 via actionlint's `download-actionlint.bash` (§7) on `.github/workflows/*.yml`. |
| `infra.yml` | `workflow_dispatch` only; inputs `env` (choice `dev\|prod`), `apply` (boolean, default false) | `environment: ${{ inputs.env }}`; `id-token: write`; `concurrency: infra-${{ inputs.env }}`, `cancel-in-progress: false`; `auth-gcp-oidc` with `vars.GCP_WIF_PROVIDER`, `vars.GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`; `terraform -chdir=infra/terraform init -backend-config=bucket=${{ vars.TF_BACKEND_BUCKET }} -backend-config=prefix=house-scanning/${{ inputs.env }}`; `plan -input=false -var-file=env/${{ inputs.env }}.tfvars -out=tfplan -detailed-exitcode` (exit 2 = changes, not failure); `show -json tfplan > tfplan.json`, `show -no-color tfplan > tfplan.txt`; upload artifact `tfplan-${{ inputs.env }}-${{ github.sha }}` (json + txt, never the binary); `apply -input=false tfplan` **only if** `inputs.apply == true`; `output -json > outputs.json` (artifact); step summary with env, SHA, plan exit code. No `-auto-approve` on an unsaved plan; never on push. |
| `deploy.yml` | `push` to `main` with paths `server/**`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `Dockerfile`, `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` → `dev`; `workflow_dispatch` inputs `env` (choice), `ref` (string, default `main`; a 40-char SHA for promotion/rollback), `strategy` (choice `rolling\|recreate`, default `rolling`) | `environment: ${{ inputs.env \|\| 'dev' }}`; `id-token: write` (fixture fetch only); `concurrency: deploy-${{ inputs.env \|\| 'dev' }}`, `cancel-in-progress: false`; checkout `ref: ${{ inputs.ref \|\| github.sha }}`; `SMP_ENVIRONMENT=$ENV GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS=${{ vars.HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS \|\| '0' }} HSS_PIPELINE_MAX_CONTAINERS=${{ vars.HSS_PIPELINE_MAX_CONTAINERS \|\| '3' }} uv run modal deploy -m server.modal_app -e $ENV --tag ${GITHUB_SHA::12} --strategy ${{ inputs.strategy \|\| 'rolling' }}` with `MODAL_TOKEN_ID`/`MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET` from the environment; verify: `curl -fsS "$CAPTURE_API_URL/v1/healthz"` retried 12 × 10 s (200 with `version`), then `auth-gcp-oidc` → `FIXTURE_SOURCE=${{ vars.FIXTURE_SOURCE }} make fixtures ONLY=all` (WS-00) → `uv run python -m server.eval.replay --packet .fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro.tar --variant arkit-nonlidar --api "$CAPTURE_API_URL" --token-env CAPTURE_API_TOKEN --finalize-at last --until processing --timeout 600 --out runs/replay/deploy-verify.json` (SD-36 flags; `--until processing` returns once finalize answered `processing`; exit 0 = pass, exit 2/3/4/5 = fail; until WS-11 PR 1 lands, `python -m server.api.replay` takes the same flags); summary: env, SHA, tag, app URL, `modal app history house-scanning -e $ENV` (last 5), `modal environment billing summary $ENV \|\| true` (a service-user token may lack billing rights), `cost_report.py --replay runs/replay/deploy-verify.json`; `timeout-minutes: 45` (a dependency change rebuilds the GPU image). |
| `gpu-bench.yml` | `workflow_dispatch` only; inputs `gpu` (choice `L4\|A10G\|A100-40GB`, default `L4`), `fixture` (default `eth3d-facade`), `variant` (choice `arkit-nonlidar\|arkit-lidar`), `max_frames` (default `40,60,70`), `cold` (boolean, default true), `spend_stop_usd` (default `40`, job fails if > 60) | `environment: dev`; `concurrency: gpu-bench`; `uv run python -m server.bench --env dev --gpu ... --fixture ... --variant ... --max-frames ... --spend-stop-usd ... --out runs/bench.jsonl` (packets read from the volume: `modal volume put house-capture-pipeline .fixtures/packets/<house>.tar packets/<house>.tar -e dev`, one-time); uploads `runs/bench.jsonl`, `runs/spend_estimate.json`, `runs/billing.json`; prints `scripts/cost_report.py --bench runs/bench.jsonl`. **Never on push or schedule.** |
| `rollover.yml` `[default chosen]` | `schedule: cron "0 5 * * *"`; `workflow_dispatch` input `env` | Matrix over `dev`, `prod` (`environment: ${{ matrix.env }}`): `uv run modal app rollover house-scanning -e $ENV --strategy rolling`. Fresh containers get a fresh `MODAL_IDENTITY_TOKEN` (static per container, ~48 h; WS-01 `/healthz` turns 503 five minutes before expiry). CPU only: `Pipeline` has `min_containers` 0 outside demo windows, and rolling never kills a running stage. |
| `e2e.yml` (WS-11 owns) | `workflow_dispatch`; nightly `cron: "17 6 * * *"` | WS-11's workflow; WS-12 supplies `./.github/actions/auth-gcp-oidc`, `vars.FIXTURE_SOURCE`, `CAPTURE_API_URL`/`CAPTURE_API_TOKEN` in `dev`, and asks WS-11 to add `permissions: id-token: write` + the auth step before `make fixtures ONLY=all` (the `gs://` mirror is private). |

### 4.6 Fallback (PR S not applied when B starts) and later migration to the shared substrate

Fallback tfvars: `github_wif_mode="own"`, `github_wif_pool_name=null`, `github_wif_provider_name=null`, `create_state_bucket=true`; repo variables `TF_BACKEND_BUCKET=hss-tfstate`, `GCP_WIF_PROVIDER=projects/<HSS_PROJECT_NUMBER>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github-actions/providers/house-scanning-server`. Bootstrap: step 1 as §4.3; then `terraform init` (local state) → `apply -var-file=env/prod.tfvars` (creates `hss-tfstate`, own pool/provider, everything else) → `terraform init -migrate-state -backend-config=bucket=hss-tfstate -backend-config=prefix=house-scanning/prod` → delete `terraform.tfstate*` locally → dev: `init -reconfigure ... prefix=house-scanning/dev && apply -var-file=env/dev.tfvars`. This is chatgraph's own precedent (`infra/chatgraph-prod-bootstrap/main.tf` in `huntertcarver/chatgraph`: own pool `github-actions`, provider `chatgraph-prod`).

Migration to shared once PR S is applied (Hunter locally, per environment): `terraform init -migrate-state -backend-config=bucket=smp-substrate-tfstate-prod -backend-config=prefix=house-scanning/<env>`; set `github_wif_mode="shared"`, the two `github_wif_*` names, `create_state_bucket=false`; `terraform state rm 'module.state_bucket[0]'` (keep the bucket until the shared state is verified); `apply` (destroys the own pool, soft-deleted 30 days; rebinds `hss-gha` to the substrate principal set); update `GCP_WIF_PROVIDER` and `TF_BACKEND_BUCKET`; dispatch `infra.yml` plan for both envs; then `gcloud storage rm -r gs://hss-tfstate`.

### 4.7 Promotion and rollback (by pinned SHA)

1. Every push to `main` deploys `dev` and records SHA, tag and URL in the run summary. Promotion = dispatch `deploy.yml` with `env=prod`, `ref=<40-char SHA already verified on dev>`; the `prod` environment enforces branch `main` and Hunter's approval.
2. Rollback = the same dispatch with the previous good SHA (from the last green prod summary or `modal app history house-scanning -e prod`, tag column). Emergency path from a laptop: `modal app rollback house-scanning -e prod` (previous version, seconds, no rebuild), then reconcile with a pinned-SHA dispatch so the deployed code equals a git SHA. `--strategy recreate` for dev when old containers must die immediately; `rolling` for prod.
3. Terraform has no auto-rollback: revert the commit, dispatch plan, review the artifact, dispatch apply.

### 4.8 Logging, alerts, cost report

1. Every service logs only through `telemetry.log_event` (§3 fields); Modal captures stdout. Events: `stage_started|stage_finished|stage_failed|stage_respawned|vlm_call|capture_check|verdict_ready|cost_summary|http_request`. Keys `service.name`, `deployment.environment` and `product` equal SMP `telemetry-bootstrap`'s resource attributes, so the OTel exporter at migration renames nothing.
2. `scripts/cost_report.py --bench runs/bench.jsonl | --logs <jsonl> | --replay <ReplayRun.json> [--cost <cost.json>]` prints a Markdown table per house/capture: `gpu`, `gpu_s`, `gpu_usd` (rate card), `vlm_usd` (sum of `vlm_call` lines, or WS-03's `cost.json`), `total_usd`, `time_to_verdict_s` (WS-11 `timings.finalize_to_verdict_s`), `disagreements`; `deploy.yml` appends it to the summary. Reference numbers (SD-38): geometry-only L4 $0.05–0.15 per house (22:28 benchmark), VLM ≈ $0.30 per house with the B3 cascade (soft baseline; hard cap $1.50 per run, WS-03); hosted-architecture §1's $0.10–0.20 / $0.75–1.8 are superseded.
3. Alert on (now: GitHub Actions failure mail, Modal budget mail, the nightly `e2e.yml`; at migration: Cloud Monitoring log-based metrics + policies with an email channel): time-to-verdict p95 > 480 s over 1 h; any `stage_failed` in 15 min; `stage_respawned` > 2 per hour; `cost_summary.vlm_usd` > 2.00 for one house; daily disagreement rate > 0.20; `/v1/healthz` failing (deploy verify, nightly E2E); GCP budget 50 %/90 %; Modal environment budget reached.

### 4.9 `docs/components/deploy.md`

Sections: rebuild commands (image, deploy, prefetch, bench), GitHub and Modal configuration names (§3), bootstrap order and fallback (§4.3, §4.6), promotion/rollback runbook (§4.7), alerts and cost report (§4.8), the GCP layout decision (§0), and the **SMP exceptions list**: (1) Cloud SQL Postgres instead of Spanner (`SMP-DEC-006`); (2) `dev` + `prod` in one GCP project (`SMP-DEC-018`, `RTM-DEC-006`, prod/non-prod co-mingling guardrail); (3) Sentry deferred; GCP-native observability only until an `OBS-DEC-009` exception is written; (4) GPU runtime (Cloud Run GPU service / Cloud Run job with `nvidia-l4`), absent from SMP's runtime rubric (`RTM-DEC-001/002/005`); (5) Modal as execution platform during the hackathon; (6) manual approval on `prod` deploys and all Terraform applies (`DLV-DEC-005` default is none) `[default chosen]`.

- Pipeline stage as `google_cloud_run_v2_job` `hss-<env>-pipeline`: GPU image from `Dockerfile` + `COPY server/`, `node_selector { accelerator = "nvidia-l4" }`, limits `cpu="8"`, `memory="24Gi"`, `"nvidia.com/gpu"="1"`, `gpu_zonal_redundancy_disabled=true`, task timeout 1500 s, `max_retries=2`, executed per run by the orchestrator (`jobs.run` with env overrides `HSS_CAPTURE_ID`, `HSS_RUN_ID`, `HSS_STAGE`); a GPU Cloud Run *service* with min 1 replaces `warm()` only if the bench shows job start latency breaks the 3-min p50.

Add `run, pubsub, sqladmin, logging, monitoring, artifactregistry` to `required_apis`.

## 7. Commands

```bash
uv sync --frozen --all-extras && make ci && uv run pytest server/tests -q                      # laptop, ~3 min (WS-00 gates + WS-12 tests)
SMP_ENVIRONMENT=dev uv run python -c "import server.modal_app"                                # no token needed
docker build -t hss-gpu:local . && docker run --rm hss-gpu:local sh -c 'colmap -h | head -1; python -c "import pycolmap, torch; print(pycolmap.__version__, torch.__version__)"'   # laptop, 15–25 min; expects pycolmap 4.2.0 (SD-34)
modal environment create dev && modal environment create prod                                  # once (Hunter)
uv run modal run scripts/modal_oidc_claims.py -e dev                                            # prints workspace_id, environment_name, app_name
SMP_ENVIRONMENT=dev uv run modal deploy -m server.modal_app -e dev --tag $(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)   # first deploy ~12 min (image), later ~1 min
uv run modal run scripts/prefetch_weights.py -e dev                                             # ~3 min, L4 not needed
curl -fsS "$CAPTURE_API_URL/v1/healthz"
FIXTURE_SOURCE=gs://hss-fixtures make fixtures ONLY=all                                        # ≈ 370 MB, needs gcloud ADC or the CI WIF token
uv run python -m server.eval.replay --packet .fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro.tar --variant arkit-nonlidar --api "$CAPTURE_API_URL" --token-env CAPTURE_API_TOKEN --finalize-at last --until processing --timeout 600 --out runs/replay/deploy-verify.json
modal volume put house-capture-pipeline .fixtures/packets/eth3d-facade.tar packets/eth3d-facade.tar -e dev   # once per environment
uv run python -m server.bench --env dev --gpu L4 --fixture eth3d-facade --variant arkit-nonlidar --max-frames 40,60,70 --spend-stop-usd 40 --out runs/bench.jsonl   # ~15 min, ≤ $10
uv run python scripts/cost_report.py --bench runs/bench.jsonl
cd infra/terraform && terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate   # laptop, 30 s
terraform init -backend-config=bucket=smp-substrate-tfstate-prod -backend-config=prefix=house-scanning/dev && terraform plan -var-file=env/dev.tfvars   # needs GCP access
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhysd/actionlint/main/scripts/download-actionlint.bash) 1.7.7 && ./actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml
```

## 10. Constraints

- Vision models are GPT-5.5 and Grok 4.7 only; this WS makes no model calls itself (bench and E2E exercise WS code). No Anthropic anywhere (image, secrets, docs).
- Never commit real meter numbers, Base SSR prompt text, API keys, tokens, service-account JSON, `tfplan`, `.terraform/`, `terraform.tfstate*`, `.env*`, or any file over 5 MB. Never paste secret values in PRs, summaries, logs, or this repo's docs; names only.
- Terraform applies only on manual dispatch with `apply=true`; never `-auto-approve` on push; plans from PR branches only against `dev`. CI SA roles are exactly §4.2: no `roles/viewer`, no `roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin`. Never set `initial_value` in `gsm_secret_namespace`. No Spanner, Redis, WorkOS, Stripe, KMS, API Gateway / LB / Cloud Armor, and no SMP validators or scaffold renderer in this repo. No CDN and no versioning on the capture bucket (WS-01).
- GPU runs never on push or schedule: `gpu-bench.yml` is dispatch-only with a spend stop; `e2e.yml` runs nightly on `dev` inside the environment budget. WS-12 spend ≤ $25 of the $200 Modal cap; keep-warm off outside demo windows.
- GCP layout (Hunter, 2026-09-26): state in `smp-substrate-tfstate-prod` under `house-scanning/<env>`; GitHub WIF through the `smp-shared-substrate` pool; shared AR/logging/monitoring/GSM in `smp-shared-prod` at migration; project-specific resources in `house-scanning`; fallback = own pool + `hss-tfstate` in `house-scanning`, migrated later. One GCP project for `dev` and `prod` (recorded SMP exception).
- No customer tools in any capture assumption. Privacy: captures are personal data (`data_class=pii`, 7-day delete for unfinalized prefixes, Nearline at 30 days, WS-01); fixtures are ETH3D (CC BY-NC-SA, evaluation only) and internal YouTube frames, never customer photos; never mirror fixture imagery into the repo or public buckets.
